description: Markov background expectations (orders 0-5), 9-mer promoter hit list, positional profile
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, re, os, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fa=pd.read_csv("https://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/current_fasta/saccharomyces_cerevisiae/dna/Saccharomyces_cerevisiae.R64-1-1.dna.toplevel.fa.gz",
               sep="\x01",header=None,compression="gzip",names=["l"],dtype=str,quoting=3).l.tolist()
genome={}; cur=None; buf=[]
for line in fa:
    if line.startswith(">"):
        if cur: genome[cur]="".join(buf)
        cur=line[1:].split()[0]; buf=[]
    else: buf.append(line.strip().upper())
genome[cur]="".join(buf)
CH=[c for c in genome if c!="Mito"]
gtf=pd.read_csv("https://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-115/gtf/saccharomyces_cerevisiae/Saccharomyces_cerevisiae.R64-1-1.115.gtf.gz",
                sep="\t",comment="#",header=None,compression="gzip",
                names=["chrom","src","feat","start","end","score","strand","frame","attr"],dtype={"chrom":str})
g=gtf[gtf.feat=="gene"].copy()
g["gene_id"]=g.attr.str.extract(r'gene_id "([^"]+)"'); g["gene_name"]=g.attr.str.extract(r'gene_name "([^"]+)"')
g["biotype"]=g.attr.str.extract(r'gene_biotype "([^"]+)"'); g["name"]=g.gene_name.fillna(g.gene_id)
g=g[(g.biotype=="protein_coding")&(g.chrom.isin(CH))].reset_index(drop=True)
def rc(s): return s.translate(str.maketrans("ACGTN","TGCAN"))[::-1]
UP=700
P=pd.DataFrame([dict(gene_id=r.gene_id,name=r.name,
                     seq=(genome[r.chrom][max(0,r.start-1-UP):r.start-1] if r.strand=="+"
                          else rc(genome[r.chrom][r.end:min(len(genome[r.chrom]),r.end+UP)])))
                for r in g.itertuples()])
nuc="".join(genome[c] for c in CH)

MAP=np.full(256,-1,dtype=np.int64)
for i,b in enumerate("ACGT"): MAP[ord(b)]=i
def enc(s): return MAP[np.frombuffer(s.encode(),dtype=np.uint8)]
def kcounts(code,k):
    n=len(code)-k+1
    idx=np.zeros(n,dtype=np.int64); ok=np.ones(n,dtype=bool)
    for i in range(k):
        c=code[i:i+n]; ok &= c>=0; idx=idx*4+np.where(c>=0,c,0)
    return np.bincount(idx[ok],minlength=4**k), ok.sum()
NUC=enc(nuc)
KC={k:kcounts(NUC,k) for k in range(1,7)}
def widx(w): 
    v=0
    for c in w: v=v*4+"ACGT".index(c)
    return v
def markov_expect(word,order):
    k=len(word); N=len(nuc)-k+1
    if order==0:
        c,tot=KC[1]; f=c/ c.sum()
        p=float(np.prod([f["ACGT".index(ch)] for ch in word]))
    else:
        num,_=KC[order+1]; den,_=KC[order]
        p=den[widx(word[:order])]/den.sum()
        for i in range(k-order):
            d=den[widx(word[i:i+order])]
            p*= num[widx(word[i:i+order+1])]/d if d else 0.0
    return 2*N*float(p)

promcat="".join(P.seq)
rows=[]
for w in ["GTTTA","AGTTTAA","AAGTTTAA","AAAGTTTAAC","AAAAGTTTAACTT"]:
    obs_g=len(re.findall("(?=%s)"%w,nuc))+len(re.findall("(?=%s)"%rc(w),nuc))
    obs_p=len(re.findall("(?=%s)"%w,promcat))+len(re.findall("(?=%s)"%rc(w),promcat))
    r=dict(word=w,len=len(w),genome_obs=obs_g,prom_obs=obs_p)
    for o in [0,1,2,3,5]: r[f"exp_M{o}"]=round(markov_expect(w,o),1)
    r["obs/exp_M3"]=round(obs_g/r["exp_M3"],2) if r["exp_M3"] else np.nan
    rows.append(r)
E=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("### genome occurrences vs Markov-background expectation (both strands) ###")
print(E.to_string(index=False)); E.to_csv("markov_background_expectations.csv",index=False)

nine="AAGTTTAAC"
hits=P[P.seq.map(lambda s:(nine in s) or (rc(nine) in s))]
print(f"\n### {len(hits)} of {len(P)} promoters contain the 9 bp site {nine} ###")
print(", ".join(sorted(hits.name)))
print("FLO11/FLO10/TEC1 among them:",[n for n in ["YIR019C","YKR102W","YBR083W"] if n in set(hits.gene_id)] or "NONE")
hits[["gene_id","name"]].to_csv("promoters_with_9bp_WOPR_site.csv",index=False)

pos=[]
for s in P.seq:
    for m in re.finditer("(?=GTTTA)",s): pos.append(-(len(s)-m.start()))
    for m in re.finditer("(?=TAAAC)",s): pos.append(-(len(s)-m.start()))
pos=np.array(pos)
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
axes[0].hist(pos,bins=70,color="#8aa0b4",edgecolor="white")
axes[0].set_xlabel("position of GTTTA relative to ATG (bp)"); axes[0].set_ylabel("occurrences")
axes[0].set_title("GTTTA sites are spread across the promoter (n=%d)"%len(pos))
x=np.arange(len(E)); w=0.38
axes[1].bar(x-w/2,E.genome_obs,w,label="observed",color="#c0392b")
axes[1].bar(x+w/2,E.exp_M3,w,label="expected, 3rd-order Markov",color="#95a5a6")
axes[1].set_yscale("symlog"); axes[1].set_xticks(x); axes[1].set_xticklabels(E.word,rotation=25,ha="right",fontsize=8)
axes[1].set_ylabel("genome occurrences (both strands)")
axes[1].set_title("Crystal-derived sites occur at or below chance"); axes[1].legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("\nartifacts:",sorted(f for f in os.listdir(".") if f.endswith(".csv")))
